basis: The official model card states that the Chinese training data was freely and permissively granted to the model trainers by LongMaoData.
zf_001 is a bundled Chinese voice pack in the same pinned model repository revision.
The official Kokoro inference library and Misaki G2P library declare Apache-2.0.
The project will synthesize only its pinned canonical story text using the bundled zf_001 voice pack; no external reference speaker audio or voice cloning input is part of this profile.
rights.boundary: This profile records permission to use the pinned model, bundled voice pack, and runtime for project narration. It does not assert exclusive ownership of the model, voice identity, training data, or universal copyrightability/non-infringement of generated audio.
